description: This file defines the StagingExtension class for Twig, which acts as a staging area for registering and managing functions, filters, node visitors, token parsers, and tests within the Twig templating environment.

classes.name: Twig\Extension\StagingExtension
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractExtension that manages registration and retrieval of functions, filters, node visitors, token parsers, and tests for Twig's environment.

methods.name: addFunction
methods.description: Registers a TwigFunction; throws exception if a function with the same name already exists.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Registers a TwigFilter; throws exception if a filter with the same name already exists.

methods.name: addTokenParser
methods.description: Registers a token parser; throws exception if a parser with the same tag already exists.

methods.name: addTest
methods.description: Registers a TwigTest; throws exception if a test with the same name already exists.
